items.source: The name of this property in the graph.
A flag if this property should be treated as read only.
items.translation: 如果此属性应被视为只读，则设置此标志。

items.source: The annotation to configure the mapping from a property to an attribute and vice versa.
items.translation: 用于配置属性与属性之间双向映射的注解。

items.source: The name of the property in the graph.

Set this attribute to true to prevent writing any value of this
property to the graph.
items.translation: 将此属性设置为 true 可防止将该属性的任何值写入图中。
